crm.imp.help:
One row per line sold (product or service). Rows with the same invoice number are grouped into one sale; without an invoice number they are grouped by client and date.
Required: date, client (tax ID or document, exact name or your client code) and unit price or line total.
Optional: invoice number, item code and description, quantity (1 if missing).
Before saving anything, a full review shows what will be loaded and which rows have problems.
